transcript:
[serious] [objective]
Ab... yahan poori honesty zaroori hai.

[scholarly] [analytical]
Ehrlichman ke parivaar ne is quote ko dispute kiya hai. Unhone kaha ye unke pita ke views se match nahi karta.

[serious] [informative]
Aur ye quote publish hua Ehrlichman ki death ke baad... jab woh khud jawab nahi de sakte the. Kuch log is quote ki authenticity pe sawaal uthate hain.

[thoughtful] [investigative]
Lekin ek baat bhi hai. Ek doosre Nixon aide... H. R. Haldeman... ke published notes mein... kuch aisi hi baatein record hain race aur policy ke baare mein.

[curious] [probing]
Toh sach kya hai?

[serious] [reflective]
Shayad hum kabhi sau percent certainty se nahi jaan payenge. Ye sawaal... ki cannabis ko criminalize karne ke peechhe kitni science thi aur kitni politics... historians aaj bhi discuss karte hain.
